description: VARIATION OF CONDITION 2 OF APPLICAITON 26/HOUSE/0102 FOR ERECTION OF A HIP TO GABLE AND REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION, SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION, INSERTION OF X2 ROOFLIGHTS, REPLACEMENT WINDOWS. AMENDMENTS TO ALLOW FOR FRONT ELEVATION TO BE FINISHED IN RENDER, REAR DORMER MATERIAL CHANGED FROM NATURAL ZINC TO BLACK ZINC
decision_conditions: <p>Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this</p><p>permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date</p><p>of permission 26/HOUSE/0102.</p><p>Reason: To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town &amp; Country Planning Act</p><p>1990.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:115%">Approved Plans - The development

</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:115%">Reason: For the avoidance of doubt
and in the interests of proper planning<o:p></o:p></p>

<p>External Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development</p><p>hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in</p><p>writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the</p><p>following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan</p><p>2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.</p>

<p>Obscured Glazing (Fixed Shut) - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied,</p><p>the windows in the side elevation at first and roof level shall be glazed with obscure glass</p><p>and fixed shut below 1.7metres and shall permanently maintained as such thereafter.</p><p>Reason: To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties</p><p>and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4</p><p>of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 &amp; D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</p>

<p>No Use of Flat Roof - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be</p><p>for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof</p><p>garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.</p><p>Reason: To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties</p><p>and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4</p><p>of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 &amp; D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</p>
